# <span id="aanchor164"></span> Create Contact Types

<div class="procedure">

To create a new contact type:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Contact Types** in the **Contacts** group.
3.  Click **New**.
4.  Enter a new contact type and click the checkboxes to enable associated devices.
5.  Click **Save**.

</div>

## Associate Contacts to Contact Types

Once Contact Types (e.g., Analyst) and contacts (e.g., John Doe) have been created, you can go to each object editor, such as Meter, Location, Liquid Cavern, Comparison Location, or Source Editor, to start associating contacts to each object.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FLOWCAL">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />FLOWCAL</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FLOWCAL">

<div class="procedure">

These steps assume a meter object is being updated.

To associate a contact to a contact type:

1.  Open the Meter Editor and select a meter number.

2.  Select **Contact Selection** from the **Tools** menu.

3.  Select the Contact Type from the list and click **Edit**.

    Only the contact types enabled for this object type will be available.

4.  Select one or more Contacts or Distribution Lists from the Select Contact screen and click **OK**.

5.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="TI2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit Integrated V2</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="TI2">

Some devices in TESTit such as Test Reports and Calibration Devices may have Contact Types associated with them. Contact Types can be used to assign these devices to a contact or group of contacts.

This functionality is only available with TESTit 2 Integrated. TESTit 3 Integrated is not supported.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Test Reports">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Test Reports</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Test Reports">

<div class="procedure">

1.  From the main screen, go to **Setup** \> **TESTit Manager** \> **Quick View Report**.
2.  All TESTit enabled meters are available from the drop-down. Select a device and click **New** to create a new test report.
3.  In the Contacts area of the test report, set the contact for each contact type displayed. One or more contacts can be added.
4.  Click **Save**.

</div>

Only the contact types enabled for TESTit will be available.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Calibration Dev">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Calibration Devices</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Calibration Dev">

<div class="procedure">

1.  From the main screen, go to **Setup** \> **TESTit Manager** \> **Calibration Device**.
2.  Select **Contact Relationships** from the **View** menu.
3.  In the Contacts area of the screen, set the contact for each contact type displayed. One or more contacts can be added.
4.  Click **Save**.

</div>

Only the contact types enabled for TESTit will be available.

</div>
